summary: The page’s audit guidance is supported by the reviewed main-source contracts, so no correction is needed. `get_event_detail` returns dispatch attempts and linked commands; `redrive_event` requeues failed dispatches and records `event.redrive.requested` on a best-effort basis. `_record_hard_delete_audit`, `log_auth_audit_event`, notification delivery, extension invocation projection, and `_retention_defaults` support the page’s specific claims. Security logging stores redacted previews best-effort, and the security observability code and UI support its scan-mode caveats. The page already qualifies behavior as source on main and installation availability as version-dependent; I did not independently verify a published release.
